decisions.reason: As a newly launched core-adjacent garage door operator with its own page, it still looks like a live option and there is too little evidence after one year to justify abandonment.

The solid wood sectional garage door appears more tentative because it was only mentioned on the site, but for a large German metal-products firm the cost of keeping this niche offer open for another year is likely still low relative to the information it can generate.

This remote-control variant overlaps with the basic operator and may eventually be folded into the main line, yet after only one year the firm would likely wait for demand uncertainty to resolve before dropping it.

Because it was only mentioned and seems close to another glazed industrial sectional door offering, its exit risk is relatively high, but the firm would still likely preserve the option briefly rather than abandon it immediately.

The insulated glazed industrial sectional door fits the firm’s established industrial door business, and with uncertainty still high the option value of retaining it likely exceeds the short-run cost of keeping it on offer.
Having its own page suggests a stronger commercial commitment, and as a close fit with the firm's industrial door portfolio it is unlikely to be withdrawn so soon after launch.
